name: persistent-memory
description: persistent-memory monorepo root — personal-first memory stack with stream MCP, optional Shared Memories connection, dashboard, API, worker, and reusable shared/db packages.

scripts.build:db: npm run prisma:generate -w @pm/db && npm run build -w @pm/db
scripts.build:update-coordinator: npm run build:update-runner && npm run build -w persistent-memory-update-coordinator && node scripts/package-update-coordinator.mjs
scripts.validate:release-upgrade: npm run build:update-runner && node scripts/validate-release-upgrade.mjs && npm run validate:legacy-update-bridge
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:db && npm run build:api && npm run build:worker && npm run build:mcp && npm run build:dashboard-gateway && npm run build:docker-control && npm run build:update-runner && npm run build:update-coordinator && npm run build:dashboard && npm run build:onboard && npm run build:server-mode-install
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:shared && npm run typecheck:db && npm run typecheck:memory-vector && npm run typecheck:graph && npm run typecheck:evidence-files && npm run typecheck:security-dlp && npm run typecheck:api && npm run typecheck:worker && npm run typecheck:mcp-runtime && npm run typecheck:mcp && npm run typecheck:docker-control && npm run typecheck:update-runner && npm run typecheck:update-coordinator && npm run typecheck:dashboard-gateway && npm run typecheck:dashboard && npm run typecheck:server-mode-install
scripts.verify:architecture: npm run test:layers && npm run test:spaces
scripts.docs:install: python3 -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check --target .local/mkdocs-python -r documentation/requirements.txt && npm ci --prefix apps/documentation
scripts.docs:build: npm run docs:generate && npm run docs:check-navigation && npm run docs:check-diagrams && PYTHONPATH=.local/mkdocs-python python3 -m mkdocs build --site-dir .local/generated-docs/site && mkdir -p .local/generated-docs/site/assets/javascripts && cp apps/documentation/node_modules/mermaid/dist/mermaid.min.js .local/generated-docs/site/assets/javascripts/mermaid.min.js
scripts.test:graphiti-usage: cd apps/graphiti-service && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_usage_telemetry.py && test -f tests/test_dependency_pins.py && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_dependency_pins.py
scripts.test: npm run test:deployment-agnosticism && npm run test:shared && npm run test:api && npm run test:worker && npm run test:mcp && npm run test:docker-control && npm run test:update-runner && npm run test:dashboard-gateway && npm run test:dashboard && npm run test:documentation && npm run test:graphiti-usage && npm run test:release-benchmark-harness && npm run test:release-benchmark-report && npm run test:system-health-report && npm run test:system-health-evidence && npm run test:recall-agent-sample && npm run test:p0-token-quality-comparison && npm run test:complete-system-health-evidence
scripts.setup: node scripts/pre-update-snapshot.mjs --from-setup && npm install && npm run prisma:generate && npm run build:update-coordinator && node scripts/install-update-coordinator.mjs --root "${PM_COORDINATOR_INSTALL_ROOT:-$PWD}" && npm ci --prefix apps/onboard && npm run build:server --prefix apps/onboard && node apps/onboard/dist/apps/onboard/server/agent-update.js
